display.purpose: Product name and first-viewport thesis only.

label.purpose: Stage, task, time, and state notation only.

motion.name: delivery-sequence
motion.value: 900ms stage cadence, 4200ms full run, synchronized cursor, progress fill, and bounded handoff pulse
motion.purpose: Show assignment, Agent execution, human confirmation, and outcome with visible live stage feedback and explicit replay.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Hover, focus, and active feedback on public controls.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single high-priority action on a public section.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 17px; border: 1px solid #1f883d; border-radius: 4px; background: #1f883d; color: #f7faf8; font: 650 14px/1.2 sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #176f31; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(31 136 61 / 35%); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A lower-priority public action beside the primary command.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 46px; padding: 11px 17px; border: 1px solid #9ba8a1; border-radius: 4px; background: #fbfcfb; color: #17201c; font: 650 14px/1.2 sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #17201c; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(31 136 61 / 35%); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Dispatch Node
components.description: A real stage on the delivery route, never a decorative status light.
components.css: .ds-dispatch-node { display: block; width: 12px; height: 12px; border: 2px solid #1f883d; border-radius: 999px; background: #f4f7f5; }

components.name: Public Navigation
components.description: Solid brand band with account actions and one structural rule.
components.css: .ds-public-nav { min-height: 64px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 0 24px; border-bottom: 1px solid #cbd3cf; background: #fbfcfb; color: #17201c; font: 650 14px/1.2 sans-serif; } .ds-public-nav a { margin-left: auto; color: #5d6963; text-decoration: none; } .ds-public-nav a:hover { color: #17201c; } .ds-public-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(31 136 61 / 35%); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Public HumanThread surfaces use operational dispatch grammar to make ownership, execution, handoff, and outcome visible. The system is light, precise, low-radius, and flat by default. One signal route connects otherwise separate product stages.
keyCharacteristics: Cool dispatch-paper fields with graphite notation.
One signal-green route that always represents active progress or action.
Asymmetric compositions built on explicit tracks and stages.
Sparse depth, clipped panels, and low-radius controls.
Motion that explains ownership, handoff, waiting, and completion.

rules.name: The Signal Has Meaning Rule
rules.body: Green identifies a current route, action, focus, or confirmed state.

rules.name: The Notation Is Not Decoration Rule
rules.body: Monospace type is used only for identifiers, time, stages, commands, and state.

rules.name: The Route Owns the Grid Rule
rules.body: Tracks and stages organize real content; decorative coordinates are not allowed.

rules.name: The Flat Operations Rule
rules.body: Elevation communicates a temporary foreground or interactive layer.

dos: Do let one signal route connect otherwise separate product stages.
Do keep demonstrations truthful and label authored sample data.
Do preserve a complete static route under reduced motion.
donts: Don't turn the public page into a wall of equal feature cards.
Don't use gradients, glows, glass, or dark terminal motifs as shorthand for AI.
Don't add route notation without real product meaning.
